_source: README.md, docs/reports/*.md, docs/ENV_V9_DESIGN.md, notebooks/v8_env_results_2026_10_31.ipynb, tools/queue_*.json. Scores on different versions are different tasks and are not directly comparable.

versions.title: v1: first simulator
changed: Deterministic C simulator with terminal frontend and an RL interface.
Preserved byte-for-byte by tools/freeze_v1.sh (commit 0f9170bd).
versions.result: Early PPO runs (unshaped, 100M-step and wall studies).
versions.wrong: Mechanics far from Terraria; old checkpoints and tapes are rejected by v4.

versions.title: v2 and v3: the game contract
changed: Recipes, controls and achievements written down as a contract (docs/reports/V2.md).
Optimised v2; v3 frozen for historical evaluation.
versions.result: v3: 18.55/32 plain PPO, 19.94/32 selected test score.
versions.wrong: Different task from v4; results are not relabelled.

versions.title: v4: core Terraria geometry
changed: 2x3 player envelope, six-tile jumps, 25-tile safe falls, 400-HP Life Crystal capacity.
Cutting a tree harvests the connected trunk; pass-through trees and furniture.
Exact light oracle and regression gates.
versions.result: 16M plain PPO: 20.79/32 on 128 untouched test worlds, furnace in 100/128 (247.5M-transition study). Five-seed memory study: 18.83/32 test, no furnace in 128 worlds.
versions.wrong: Crafting is the gate: wood and a workbench in range rarely coincide; more compute did not guarantee progress.

versions.title: v5: object scale
changed: Chest, Life Crystal, furnace, campfire, bench and anvil footprints from the original art.
versions.result: Plain PPO five-seed means 13.79 (v4) to 17.32 (v5), furnace coverage 6.6% to 38.8% (503M transitions, 30 runs).
versions.wrong: Spatial-target and memory packages almost never craft benches on v5; effects are package dependent.

versions.title: v6 and v7: pickaxe ownership, ore supply, direct selection
changed: Independent pickaxe ownership and ore supply.
One-action direct inventory selection.
v7 frozen as the common RL and LLM environment.
versions.result: v7 reward study (Oct 17): five-seed means 16.68/32 (equal reward, gamma .999), gamma 1.0 lowers scores by 0.99. LLM harness: Sol smoke 9/32 for $0.28; Luna 20 and 19/32 for $0.41 and $0.44, both died.
versions.wrong: Exact-minimum iron produced an unfair cliff; no v7 condition reached a furnace at final validation in the 16M study.

versions.title: Exploration study (v4 mechanics)
changed: Training-only aids screened against a paired PPO control at 16M.
versions.result: Potential-based recipe shaping is the first change that reliably passes the furnace: +1.41/32, furnace worlds 1.5 to 23 of 128. Best 48M policy 21.67/32.
versions.wrong: Return to surface is reachable (scripted 39/39) but never learned; self-imitation and cell novelty hurt.

versions.title: Scaling on eg15 (8x MI350X)
changed: Max-speed PPO path: 1,024 envs, bf16, compiled graphs, about 287k steps/s per GPU.
Width, depth and memory sweeps at 512M to 2B steps.
versions.result: Width was flat across 83x parameters; memory cost 1.8x to 4x time per step for no gain.
versions.wrong: Two trainers per GPU silently corrupted gradients (docs/reports/GPU_SHARING_CORRUPTION_2026_10.md); all conclusions use one run per GPU.

versions.title: v8: environment knobs
changed: Ore and tree supply, view size, world width, episode length and log-scale inventory as build knobs; defaults reproduce v7.
116 PPO runs from 512M to 6B steps; five seeds for each final configuration; reserved test worlds used once.
versions.result: Ore 3x + trees 2x: +0.9 on test. Generic arm at gamma .9998: 28.00/32 test IQM; shaped arm 27.98. One 6B shaped run: 29.33/32, iron pickaxe in 99/128 worlds, return to surface in 104/128.
versions.wrong: Gold pickaxe and iron chainmail never crafted; larger worlds cost up to 6 points; v8 is too close to saturation to release.

versions.title: viz: the simulator in the browser
changed: v8 core compiled to WebAssembly, byte-identical to v7, with the 2.1B-step policy evaluated in C.
Play, watch, 256 parallel worlds, and a step-by-step look at observation, action, reward, network and state.
versions.result: wasm and native agree on Env, Obs and mask hashes over 80 worlds; forward pass matches PyTorch to 7.6e-6.
versions.wrong: Needs a local Terraria install for the art.

versions.title: Real Terraria speed
changed: tModLoader 1.4.4 dedicated server ticked in a tight loop by a server-side mod.
versions.result: About 1,000 agent actions per second per process (4 ticks per action), 3,500 with 4 processes.
versions.wrong: Client-side player logic (pickup, damage, melee, cursor tools, crafting) does not run headless yet.

versions.title: v9: a layered world with night and a boss
changed: 128x128 layered world, day and night, Zombies, Demon Eyes, Skeletons, Demon Altars, Eye of Cthulhu.
38 achievements in four tiers weighted 1/3/5/8; headline is percent of the weighted maximum (129).
Sim-cost gate passes: 1.23M steps/s (0.95x of v8).
versions.result: PPO pilots (Nov 8, 128 validation worlds): generic 56.1% at 1B steps (mean of 5 seeds, IQM 57.3%), shaped 54.4%; 4B steps, a minimap and an LSTM did not help. LLM campaign (Nov 8): Claude Haiku 5.5 with a game guide and macros 53.0% mean over 3 public worlds (67.4 / 24.0 / 67.4), about $1 per full episode; GPT-5.6 Luna 24.0%.
versions.wrong: Too easy in the middle and a cliff at the top: tiers 1 to 3 are learned almost at once, tier 4 stops at the lens, and no run crafts the iron pickaxe, even at 10 bars instead of 12. Generic PPO at 1B is far above the 25 to 35% target band.

versions.title: Craftax calibration
changed: Official Craftax_Baselines ppo.py and ppo_rnn.py rerun unmodified on eg15 at 1B steps, 3 seeds each, plus ppo.py with our Terraria-Lite settings.
versions.result: PPO 12.1% of the maximum reward against the published 11.9%; PPO-RNN 16.2% against 15.3%. Our pipeline reproduces the published baselines.
versions.wrong: Our Terraria-Lite PPO settings score only 5.3% on Craftax; that run changed five settings at once, so it does not say which one hurts.

versions.title: v8fid: real-Terraria behaviour on v8
changed: Five knobs port mob AI, combat, physics, mining and trees from Terraria's source onto v8.
Generic PPO at 2B steps on each port.
versions.result: Mob AI, combat, physics and trees cost little or nothing (27.44 to 28.29 of 32 against 27.97 with every port off). Real mining at 4 game ticks per action drops the score to 17.15 with no furnace; at 15 ticks per action all five ports recover to 25.49.
versions.wrong: Mining at 4 ticks per action starves the policy of wood and stone, so v10 uses 15 game ticks per action.

versions.title: v10: the release candidate
changed: v9 plus the five behaviour ports, all on, at 15 game ticks per action (one action is a quarter second).
Two tier-4 stepping stones: find a Demon Altar, hold 6 lenses; 40 achievements, weighted maximum 145.
Simulator 0.67M steps/s on one thread (0.52x of v8); training is network-bound.
versions.result: PPO at 1B steps (3 seeds, validation worlds): generic 32.1 to 32.8%, shaped 33.6 to 34.9%, inside the 25 to 35% target band; 4B steps no better. With every port off the same arm scores 59.2 and 58.9%.
versions.wrong: No ported build returns to the surface or collects a lens: not a bug, but surface nights are far deadlier under the enemy and combat ports. Night difficulty tuning is open (DECISIONS.md B2, B4).

in_progress.detail: Night spawn period 120 and 180 steps instead of 60, and weaker night mobs under the ported combat, so that returning to the surface becomes learnable (DECISIONS.md B4).
Scripted planner per world under the step limit, after the night tuning (DECISIONS.md B7).
Guide and macros updated for the real-Terraria physics, then the v9 model list on v10 (DECISIONS.md D2, D3).
